Descripción de la compañía.

Ferrero es una empresa familiar con una perspectiva verdaderamente mundial y progresista y marcas icónicas como Nutella®, Tic Tac®, Ferrero Rocher®, Raffaello®, Kinder Bueno® y Kinder Sorpresa®. El amor por nuestras marcas sigue creciendo al igual que lo hace nuestro alcance internacional. Representada en más de 50 países y con productos vendidos en más de 170, el Grupo Ferrero encanta a numerosas generaciones en todo el planeta. ¿Cuál es el secreto de nuestro éxito mundial? 40,000 empleados especializados que celebran tanto el cuidado como la calidad para forjar un negocio, carreras profesionales y marcas de las que nos sentimos orgullosos. Participarás en la creación e implementación de proyectos de trade marketing, orientados a mejorar la experiencia de compra y fortalecer la presencia de nuestras marcas en el punto de venta.

Ferrero comenzó su trayectoria en la pequeña ciudad de Alba en Piamonte, Italia, en 1946. Hoy en día, es una de las empresas de alimentos dulces envasados más grandes del mundo, con muchas marcas icónicas que se venden en todo el mundo. Descubre más sobre Ferrero en ferrero.com

title: Academic Partnerships Intern – Digital Marketing & Audience Engagement | Academic Partnerships
description:
Job Description

Bring It

You are a university student who enjoys communication, digital content, and working with people. You bring proficient written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and an interest in education and technology. You can create engaging content using Microsoft PowerPoint, Canva, Microsoft 365, and social media platforms. You communicate confidently in English and Spanish, while Portuguese is a plus. You can work from the SAP office in Monterrey, Mexico, at least three days per week.

Build It

You will create emails, newsletters, social posts, presentations, invitations, and internal communications for Academic Partnerships. You will help plan and deliver virtual, hybrid, and in-person events across Latin America and the Caribbean. Your work will include coordinating speakers, registrations, venues, communications, and event logistics. You will engage with universities, educators, students, customers, and SAP teams across multiple countries. You will also maintain contact lists, reports, presentations, and activity records. Your work will help SAP connect education communities with SAP technologies, experts, and learning opportunities.

Belong

You will join a regional team that connects SAP with universities, schools, educators, and students. The team works across countries and cultures to create useful learning experiences and stronger connections between academia and industry. You will gain regional exposure, work with different SAP functions, and build relationships across the educational ecosystem. You will also develop your communication, project coordination, digital marketing, and stakeholder management skills through real projects.

description:
PRÁCTICAS PROFESIONALES Y SERVICIO SOCIAL | COMUNICACIÓN




CADICZA

Departamento · Comunicación y Relaciones Públicas

Modalidad de incorporación · Prácticas profesionales o servicio social.

Modalidad · En línea

País · México

Plazas disponibles · 3




1. DESCRIPCIÓN GENERAL DE LA POSICIÓN




CADICZA, despacho de arquitectura especializado en diseño residencial de lujo, busca integrar estudiantes al área de Comunicación y Relaciones Públicas para fortalecer la presencia pública de la marca, establecer vínculos con medios de comunicación y apoyar la difusión de proyectos e iniciativas del despacho.




La convocatoria está dirigida a estudiantes de Comunicación, Relaciones Públicas, Periodismo, Comunicación Organizacional, Mercadotecnia o carreras afines que quieran adquirir experiencia en comunicación de marca, gestión de prensa y planificación de lanzamientos.




2. ACTIVIDADES Y RESPONSABILIDADES DEL DÍA A DÍA




* Apoyar en la gestión de la marca CADICZA desde el área de relaciones públicas, cuidando la coherencia de sus mensajes y su presentación ante públicos externos.

* Investigar y actualizar el directorio de medios, periodistas y editores de arquitectura, diseño, cultura e interés general.

* Preparar mensajes de acercamiento y dar seguimiento a propuestas de cobertura, entrevistas y colaboraciones con medios.

* Redactar y editar comunicados de prensa, fichas informativas y materiales para la difusión de proyectos.

* Apoyar en la planificación de lanzamientos de proyectos e iniciativas, organizando calendarios, materiales y fechas de difusión.

* Registrar contactos, respuestas y publicaciones para dar seguimiento a los resultados de cada acción de comunicación.




3. REQUISITOS




Escolaridad




* Cursar Comunicación, Relaciones Públicas, Periodismo, Comunicación Organizacional, Mercadotecnia o una carrera afín.

* Estudiar en una institución educativa en México y reunir los requisitos académicos para iniciar prácticas profesionales o servicio social.




Aptitudes




* Buena redacción, ortografía y capacidad para adaptar el tono a distintos públicos.

* Organización para dar seguimiento a contactos, tareas y fechas de entrega.

* Criterio para identificar medios y oportunidades de difusión relevantes para cada proyecto.

* Iniciativa, atención al detalle y disposición para colaborar a distancia.




Software y herramientas




* Manejo de correo electrónico y herramientas de trabajo en línea como Google Docs, Sheets y Drive.

* Se valorará la experiencia con herramientas de planificación editorial, monitoreo de medios o diseño de presentaciones.




Otros




* Residir en México y contar con disponibilidad para cumplir las horas acordadas en modalidad remota.

* Tener interés en la comunicación aplicada a la arquitectura, el diseño o la cultura.




4. BENEFICIOS




Esquema de participación




Prácticas profesionales o servicio social sin remuneracion. La acreditación de horas está sujeta a la autorización de la institución educativa y a la formalización de los documentos correspondientes.




Desarrollo profesional en CADICZA




* Experiencia práctica en relaciones públicas, gestión de prensa y comunicación de marca dentro de un despacho de arquitectura.

* Participación en la preparación y difusión de lanzamientos, desde la definición del mensaje hasta el seguimiento de la cobertura.

* Retroalimentación sobre textos, propuestas de difusión y materiales de comunicación.

* Créditos de colaboración cuando corresponda, acceso a la bolsa de trabajo y acceso a los beneficios de salud disponibles, conforme a sus condiciones.




5. FORMATO DE POSTULACIÓN




Envía tu CV mediante la opción de postulación de LinkedIn o al correo vinculacion@cadicza.com




SOLO PARA PRACTICAS PROFESIONALES Y SERVICIO SOCIAL / SOLO UNIVERSITARIOS

description:
WinDifferent specializes in helping businesses achieve rapid and sustainable growth through our powerful proprietary marketing system. Our data-driven solutions generate positive engagement that leads to ready-to-close opportunities, massively expanding sales pipelines and enabling companies to scale faster than the competition.




As one of WinDifferent's best success stories, BairesDev helps us to find the best talent worldwide and invites them to explore our continually growing job opportunities.




Campaign Manager at WinDifferent




As a Campaign Manager at WinDifferent, you'll be responsible for owning the full lifecycle of email campaigns, from understanding our partners' products, ICPs, and sales funnels to launching and optimizing targeted, high-performing campaigns. You'll manage a portfolio of around 30 partner accounts at a time, requiring strong organization, time management, and communication skills. Daily responsibilities include meeting with partners, crafting and segmenting campaigns, coordinating with internal teams, tracking performance, and continuously testing and iterating for better results. You'll also use AI tools throughout your work and contribute to AI projects that improve our internal processes and campaign optimization. Your core objectives are to hit campaign performance goals, keep partners engaged and satisfied, and help improve how the team runs campaigns. The role is both strategic and hands-on, offering the challenge of balancing creativity, data, and partner relationships to drive measurable impact.




What you will do:




- Collaborate closely with multiple WinDifferent clients to gather requirements, understand their value proposition, and align on key messaging, goals, and campaign strategy.

- Analyze each client's product or service to identify their unique selling points and tailor email campaigns that resonate with their Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).

- Oversee the full project lifecycle of email campaigns, managing timelines, coordinating with internal teams, handling multiple client accounts, and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality campaigns.

- Develop, segment, and execute targeted email marketing campaigns, while continuously monitoring performance metrics to iterate and optimize for engagement and conversions.

- Implement and manage A/B testing strategies to refine messaging, design, and calls to action, leveraging results to maximize lead generation and overall campaign effectiveness.




What we are looking for:




- 4+ years of marketing experience.

- 2+ years in client-facing roles.

- 2+ years in project or account management.

- 2+ years working at or with international companies.

- Experience managing marketing email campaigns.

- Good level of English.




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work.

- Work-from-home hardware setup.

- Flexible hours - make your schedule.

- PTO, parental leave, and other special leaves.

- English classes.

- Personal loans with 0% interest, following the company's policies.

- Udemy for Business (subject to manager's approval).

- An excellent compensation package — well above the market average.

- You can grow at the speed of your learning curve.

- An innovation-driven, diverse, and multicultural work environment that provides the support and resources for its professionals to thrive.

- The chance and resources to be a game-changer for one of America's fastest-growing companies.




Join a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive and make a significant impact!

description:
At Rush Street Interactive (NYSE: RSI), we’re reimagining play, together. Through BetRivers.com, PlaySugarHouse.com and RushBet.co, we create digital entertainment experiences that are rewarding, responsible and built with players in mind. While fun and games are our product, you’ll join a group of industry leaders dedicated to driving a differentiated, sophisticated iGaming experience.

Interested? Game on.

The Community Manager — Sports & Entertainment is responsible for managing, engaging, and growing Rushbet's online communities across social media platforms in México. The role shapes the brand's tone and daily presence within the sports, entertainment, and online gaming categories, ensuring content is dynamic, authentic, aligned with marketing objectives, and compliant with the regulations of a licensed betting brand. The position sits within the Brand & Content team and works closely with copywriters, designers, the talent/creator team, paid media, and the creative team.

What You'll Do


Develop and execute social media and community strategies tailored to Mexican sports and entertainment audiences. 
Manage the brand's daily social media presence (Instagram, X/Twitter, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Threads), promoting interaction and audience growth. 
Create, curate, and schedule relevant and engaging content that reflects the brand's identity and tone, executing the content calendar in coordination with the Brand & Content team. 
Monitor and participate in real time in conversations around sports, entertainment, and gaming — match days, trending moments, and fan culture — identifying opportunities to engage. 
Act as the authentic voice of the brand, ensuring consistent communication across all digital touchpoints and adapting tone to Mexican sports and internet culture. 
Collaborate with Design, Content, Paid Media, and Brand teams to ensure campaign alignment and maximize impact, following the team's creative approval workflows. 
Coordinate with the talent/creator team on the publication, amplification, and performance follow-up of brand ambassador and influencer content. 
Ensure every published interaction and piece complies with México's advertising regulations (SEGOB) and responsible gaming guidelines — in a licensed betting brand, community management is a regulated touchpoint. 
Analyze and report community performance metrics, engagement levels, and sentiment insights to guide content strategies. 
Manage reputation and crisis communication across channels when necessary, escalating according to the team's protocols. 
Stay up to date on social media trends, Mexican sports culture, and industry best practices, especially within sports betting and casino marketing. 


What You'll Bring


Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Advertising, or related disciplines (or equivalent experience). 
4+ years managing social media communities for sports, entertainment, or online gaming brands. 
Proven understanding of Mexican sports audiences and fan engagement (Liga MX, national team, boxing, NFL fandom), preferably within sports betting or casino categories. 
Native command of Mexican Spanish and deep fluency in Mexican internet and sports culture; based in México with authorization to work in the country. 
Strong storytelling and copywriting skills adaptable to each platform's formats and codes. 
Proficiency in social media management tools (Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Later, Meta Business Suite, or similar). 
Experience using social media analytics tools and preparing performance reports. 
Ability to design and execute content calendars and engagement initiatives. 
Sound judgment for real-time publishing in a regulated industry — knowing what the brand can and cannot say. 
Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving abilities. 
English proficiency: B1–B2 — sufficient for internal coordination and content review. 
Passion for sports, entertainment, and digital culture, with a proactive and trend-driven mindset. 
Desirable: experience handling reputation or crisis situations in high-visibility accounts. 


The role requires ongoing awareness of gaming advertising regulations and responsible gaming guidelines in México (SEGOB), including what a licensed betting brand can publish and how it may engage publicly with its audience.

Aviso de Privacidad para Candidatos

En cumplimiento de lo establecido en la Ley Federal de Protección de Datos Personales en Posesión de los Particulares (LFPDPPP) y su respectivo Reglamento, Rush Street Interactive México, S. de R.L. de C.V. con domicilio en Blvd. Manuel Ávila Camacho 24, Piso 21, Lomas de Chapultepec, Miguel Hidalgo, 11000 CDMX, México (en adelante, “RSI”); es el Responsable de los datos personales que nos proporcione, por lo que hace de su conocimiento el presente Aviso de Privacidad con el fin de que conozca cómo se tratarán sus datos personales.

I. Datos Personales recolectados

Los datos personales que RSI puede llegar a tratar pertenecen a las siguientes categorías:

Datos de identificación. Nombre completo, domicilio, edad, sexo, fecha de nacimiento, lugar de nacimiento, nacionalidad, Registro Federal de Contribuyentes (R.F.C.), número de Seguridad Social, Clave Única de Registro de Población (C.U.R.P.), estado civil, firma, fotografías o imágenes de su persona.

Datos de contacto. Domicilio completo, correo electrónico, número de teléfono móvil y/o fijo.

Datos financieros o patrimoniales. Información resultante de los estudios socioeconómicos que se lleven a cabo, salario actual, otras percepciones, información de cuenta bancaria, constancia de situación fiscal, clave interbancaria.

Datos laborales y académicos. Antecedentes laborales y académicos, certificados de estudio, currículum vitae, desempeño laboral, información relacionada con trabajos anteriores.

RSI También Podría Tratar Los Siguientes Datos Personales Que Se Consideran Como Sensibles (en Lo Sucesivo Se Entenderán Incluidos Cuando Se Haga Referencia a “Datos Personales”)

Datos de Salud. Estado de salud actual y pasado, tipo de sangre.

Datos Biométricos: Huella dactilar.

RSI puede recolectar los datos personales mediante la entrega directa por su parte a través de cualquier medio de contacto. También puede recolectar datos personales de manera indirecta a través de fuentes de acceso público y de otras fuentes disponibles en el mercado.

II. Finalidades del Tratamiento

Los datos personales que nos proporcione, serán tratados para las siguientes finalidades:


Solicitar la hoja de vida y documentos anexos para su evaluación. 
Comunicarse por cualquier medio de contacto suministrado cuando se requiera para continuar con el proceso de selección. 
Verificar antecedentes, información personal, experiencia laboral y profesional como parte del proceso de selección. 
Contar con un registro de las personas que se presentaron en cada proceso de selección y sus resultados. 
Reportar información a las autoridades competentes en caso de que se requerido. 
Verificar información en cumplimiento de regulaciones vigentes como la relacionada con los requerimientos para la prevención del lavado de activos y la financiación del terrorismo. 
Cualquier otra finalidad directamente relacionada con los procesos de selección que adelante RSI. 


III. Transferencias de datos personales

Sus datos personales podrán ser transferidos, de conformidad con lo establecido en la LFPDPPP, en los casos en los que RSI no requiera el consentimiento del Titular para realizar transferencias de datos personales nacionales o internacionales de acuerdo con lo previsto en el artículo 37 de la LFPDPPP o en cualquier otro caso de excepción previsto por la misma u otra legislación aplicable.

description:
The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly organized and strategic Marketing Resource Manager to become the operational backbone of our client campaigns. This role is for a natural leader who excels at the intersection of project management, client strategy, and marketing execution. You will be the strategic linchpin for our campaign delivery, ensuring all moving parts—from SEO and content to creative and client services—are perfectly synchronized and optimized for success.

We are looking for a dedicated professional who values ownership and results over clock-watching, and understands that in a fast-growing company, excellence comes from productivity, not rigid schedules.

What You'll Do

Campaign & Resource Management:

Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of integrated marketing campaigns (SEO, Content, Social, etc.), from strategic planning and resource allocation to final reporting.

Manage the allocation and scheduling of our marketing team (SEO specialists, strategists, copywriters, designers), ensuring optimal workload distribution and project flow.

Drive project timelines using tools like monday.com, proactively identifying risks and removing roadblocks to ensure on-time delivery.

Strategic Account Management

Serve as a trusted marketing advisor to our clients, translating their business objectives into actionable marketing strategies and project plans.

Lead key client communications, facilitating strategic discussions, managing expectations, and building lasting partnerships based on performance and trust.

Cross-Functional Team Leadership

Act as the central point of communication, ensuring seamless collaboration between our SEO, Content, Developers and Paid Media teams.

Facilitate strategic planning sessions and internal briefings to ensure the entire team is aligned on campaign goals and execution plans.

Ensure all creative and content deliverables are on-brand, high-quality, and strategically sound before they reach the client.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For:

A Strategic Thinker & An Operational Expert

You can see the big picture of a client's business goals and can build and manage the detailed project plan to get there.

Data-Informed & Creatively-Minded

You respect the data and use it to guide decisions, but you also have a strong sense of brand and storytelling that helps you to understand the decision makers strategies.

A Master Orchestrator

You excel at bringing different specialists together (SEO, content, design) to work as a cohesive and effective unit. Your organizational skills are legendary.

An Expert Relationship Builder & Diplomat

Demonstrates strong diplomacy and relationship management skills, with a talent for managing diverse and high-performing personalities effectively.

An Agile Builder

Thrives in the building phase of a company's growth and possesses the agility to make quick pivots as priorities evolve.

Adaptable & Versatile

You have experience across various industries and can quickly grasp the marketing challenges and opportunities within new client verticals.

Client-Obsessed

You are dedicated to client success and have a proven ability to build strong, collaborative relationships.

Skills & Qualifications

5+ years of professional experience in marketing project management, account management, or marketing operations, preferably within a digital agency setting.

Demonstrable experience managing integrated digital marketing campaigns (SEO, content marketing, social media, etc.).

Expertise in project management software (e.g., monday.com, Asana, Wrike) and workflow optimization.

Deep understanding of the entire marketing funnel and the role each channel plays.

Strong, practical knowledge of SEO principles and how they inform a successful content strategy.

Exceptional client-facing communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.

Experience with analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, SEMrush) is highly desirable.

Familiarity with tools like Google Workspace, Figma, and ChatGPT.

Bonus Points

Experience in B2B or home services industries.

Benefits

A Note on Our Demands & Your Rewards

Let's be transparent: the expectations here are exceptionally high. This role demands a significant investment of your time, energy, and intellectual horsepower. It requires resilience and a proactive, problem-solving mindset that goes far beyond a 9-to-5 checklist.

This role is not for everyone.

However, for the right person, the rewards are immense. You are not a cog in a machine here. You are a critical driver of our clients' success and our agency's growth. You will be challenged, you will grow faster than you thought possible, and you will see the direct, tangible impact of your strategic work every single day. If you are a builder who is energized by that level of responsibility and impact, you will thrive here.

What We Offer

Competitive salary commensurate with your experience and impact from $2,000 to $4,000 USD/month

A competitive benefits package (details may vary based on your location).

Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and company holidays.

A fully remote and flexible work environment.

A dedicated budget for professional development, courses, and conferences.

The opportunity to shape the trajectory of a rapidly growing agency.

With The Subject Line

At The End Of Your Email, Include The Phrase

"Regex SEO thrives on clarity and speed."

Working in close collaboration with the Marketing Communication / Branding and Digital Communication Centers of Excellence plus Global Category Leads and regional commercial / marketing teams, this global position will develop the sales enablement tools and training needed to be successful in the market.

Role Description




Our client is the business texting platform recruiters, staffing firms, healthcare and service 

teams use to reach people where they actually respond. We sell direct and through channel partners 

who white-label our client inside their own software. We're growing fast, and the first two weeks of a 

customer's life set the tone for everything after.

About the role. You own the launch. From the moment a deal closes, you are the customer's expert 

guide: you run kickoff, design their configuration, steer their carrier registration to a first-time approval, 

build their workspace, train their team and hand them off live. You'll launch our client's customers as an

training, and make sure each one ends with decisions, owners and next steps.

registration, phone numbers, integrations and customer homework. Spot slippage early and 

resolve it or escalate with a recommendation.

when plans change, and report progress, risks and trends to your lead each week.

• Land a clean handoff. Confirm go-live criteria are met, hand each customer to Customer Success 

with a complete record, and partner with Support to troubleshoot early issues after launch.

done, and help automate the manual steps.




Who you are

• 2–4 years in SaaS implementation, onboarding, technical support or solutions work, ideally B2B 

and communications or telecom.

• You run a customer call like a consultant: clear agenda, firm next steps, friendly and direct.

• You're comfortable in admin consoles and ticket queues, and you can learn carrier and 

compliance rules fast.

• You manage 15+ live projects at once without dropping a follow-up.

• You write clearly enough that a customer can act on your email without a call.

description:
Responsibilities
The authenticity of TikTok has created a new way for brands and partners to meaningfully connect with creators and the community. Through an innovative E-commerce platform that helps discover and purchase products within the app, TikTok E-commerce enhances promotion and sales for partners and brands with an entertaining user experience.

Are you passionate about revolutionizing the E-commerce experience? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where creativity meets strategy? Join our TikTok Shop Partnership (TSP) team as we shape the future of social E-commerce. The team is in charge of managing Partners - agencies who service brands on TikTok and responsible for partners' performance.

We are looking for an account manager to onboard, incubate and support Partners in the Mexico market. As the Partnership Development and Operations Manager, you will play a pivotal role in expanding and driving the TSP ecosystem.

The role Partnership Development and Operations Manager is to expand and drive the TSP ecosystem through business development, training and project management. This position sits cross-functionally, working closely with stakeholders from different business units and external parties to support in matchmaking TSPs with partners on the platform. This candidate will take part in onboarding and education of partners, from smaller TikTok savvy agencies to media companies. You will become an expert on social E-commerce and all things to support our partners and help them to onboard their clients and grow sales on the platform. The position requires data analysis of various metrics, from livestreams and short videos, to identify opportunities to help TSPs support sellers to succeed on TikTok.

Responsibilities:
- Establish TikTok as the E-commerce platform of choice for brands by building strong relationships and exploring partnership opportunities with E-commerce and digital marketing agencies across core functions including: creative, social, production, logistics and influencer marketing.
- Establish themselves as the primary liaison, TikTok advocate and owner of client relationships for their respective agencies.
- Support partners throughout their onboarding and incubation on the platform, including identifying opportunities, providing strategic briefs, training, and consultation.
- Be responsible for TSP performance and growth by educating and training TSPs with best practices across live strategy, analysis and diagnosis of traffic and performance data.
- Design and launch TSP incentives and activities to encourage TSP's engagement.
- Focus on new agencies in the E-commerce ecosystem - building them up and developing them into successful and thriving TSP agencies.
- Utilise data proficiently to deeply understand pain points, formulate business requirements, identify opportunities and prioritise solutions.

Minimum Qualifications:
- +1 years of experience and a Bachelor's degree.
- Experience in partnership development and account management.
- Critical thinking, analytical skills with an entrepreneurial and proactive mind-set.
- Data driven; an analytical thinker experienced in using data and metrics to drive decisions.
- Have a strategic mindset and high curiosity to deeply understand the inner workings of social E-commerce.
- Ability to work cross-functionally with multiple teams and stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Self-starter, rapid learner and able to navigate fast-paced work environments and to thrive.
- Proven track record of managing multiple projects simultaneously and prioritising work based on the needs of the business.
- Excellent communication skill.
- Great at building trusted relationships with platform partners.
- Experience in account management within tech companies, E-commerce platforms, or agencies is preferred.
- Established network within agency contacts across creative, social, production, or influencer agencies.
- Creative thinker with a knack for devising innovative strategies.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for an Analyst, Digital Media Analytics who will support the measurement and reporting of B2B advertising campaigns for a global professional services client.

In this role, you will use T-SQL, Power BI, and Excel to extract, organize, analyze, and visualize campaign data. You will collaborate with Investment, Planning, and senior Analytics teams to ensure accurate reporting, monitor campaign performance and spend pacing, and identify gaps in the data.

Key responsibilities include:


Extract, organize, and format campaign data from advertising management platforms to support analysis and reporting. 
Use T-SQL and Excel to retrieve, prepare, and analyze data, supporting accurate and consistent campaign reporting. 
Maintain, update, and perform quality assurance checks on dashboards and recurring reports in Power BI and Tableau. 
Produce campaign performance and spend pacing reports across multiple campaigns and client service lines. 
Perform recurring tracking tag QA checks to verify correct functionality and support accurate data flows. 
Help senior Analytics team members translate media metrics into clear visualizations and presentations that support decision-making. 
Review campaign objectives and performance data with the team to identify optimization opportunities and potential measurement solutions. 
Collaborate with Investment and Planning teams to gather campaign information and ensure complete reporting coverage. 
Identify and help resolve data gaps, discrepancies, and reporting issues, working with relevant teams to improve information quality. 


Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:


1–2 years of relevant professional experience in data analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or digital media analytics. 
Hands-on experience with data extraction, organization, and analysis. 
Practical experience using T-SQL to retrieve and analyze data. 
Experience using Power BI to maintain dashboards, visualize information, and support reporting. 
Proficiency in Excel for preparing, organizing, and analyzing datasets. 
Strong attention to detail and the ability to validate data, identify discrepancies, and maintain reporting accuracy. 
Good communication skills, with the ability to explain findings clearly and coordinate with different stakeholders. 
A collaborative approach to working with Investment, Planning, and Analytics teams. 
Organizational skills to support multiple campaigns and recurring reporting deadlines. 
Experience with Databricks is a plus. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

En FEMSA y todos nuestros negocios, los procesos de reclutamiento y selección son gratuitos y operan con principios de respeto por el individuo, la sociedad y el medio ambiente sin hacer distinción alguna por religión, género, edad, nivel socioeconómico, origen étnico, discapacidad u otros.

Responsable de Marketing y GTM | OXXO MEDIA

Construye el posicionamiento de una nueva generación de Retail Media en México.

¿Te entusiasma desarrollar estrategias de marketing que conecten marcas, audiencias y oportunidades de negocio? Esta es una oportunidad para liderar la estrategia de Marketing y Go to Market de OXXO Media, impulsando el posicionamiento de una propuesta de valor innovadora dentro del ecosistema de Retail Media en México.

Desde esta posición tendrás la oportunidad de construir la narrativa de una categoría en crecimiento, desarrollar estrategias para atraer anunciantes y fortalecer la presencia de OXXO Media en el mercado, conectando marketing con resultados comerciales.

¿Cuál será tu impacto?


Construcción de estrategia: Diseñar y liderar el plan anual de Marketing B2B, definiendo posicionamiento, mensajes y propuestas de valor para los diferentes segmentos del mercado.
Go to Market: Desarrollar estrategias de comunicación comercial que traduzcan las capacidades de OXXO Media en propuestas atractivas para clientes y anunciantes.
Generación de demanda: Impulsar iniciativas de generación de leads a través de contenido, campañas, eventos y alianzas con actores relevantes de la industria.
Construcción de marca: Fortalecer el posicionamiento de OXXO Media mediante estrategias de contenido, casos de éxito, thought leadership y presencia en medios especializados.
Liderazgo de ecosistema: Dirigir agencias de contenido y producción, así como coordinar iniciativas estratégicas con equipos comerciales y otras áreas del negocio.
Desarrollo de mercado: Liderar OXXO Media Academy, una iniciativa de educación y evangelización del mercado para clientes, agencias y equipos internos.
Experiencias de marca: Representar a OXXO Media en foros y eventos relevantes de la industria, generando oportunidades de relacionamiento y negocio.


¿Por qué es una oportunidad atractiva?

Es una posición con la posibilidad de construir, no solamente ejecutar. Tendrás exposición a diferentes áreas del negocio, participación en decisiones estratégicas de marketing y una conexión directa con los objetivos comerciales de OXXO Media.

Podrás contribuir al desarrollo de una categoría emergente en México, posicionar una propuesta de valor diferenciada y dejar tu huella en la evolución del Retail Media.

El reto: transformar una propuesta innovadora de medios en una marca relevante, una narrativa comercial poderosa y un motor de generación de oportunidades de negocio.

Tu misión: hacer que el mercado conozca, entienda y elija OXXO Media.

En FEMSA Servicios estamos comprometidos con asegurar entornos inclusivos, por lo tanto no discriminamos a las personas haciendo algún tipo de distinción, exclusión o manifestando alguna preferencia que no sea objetiva, racional, ni proporcional y que tenga por objeto obstaculizar, restringir, impedir, menoscabar o anular el reconocimiento, goce o ejercicio de los derechos humanos y libertades por cualquier motivo, incluyendo de origen, raza, estado civil, edad, opinión, género, credo, tribu, asociación o afiliación a un sindicato, etnicidad, clase social o económica, embarazo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, condición de salud, discapacidad o nacionalidad.

About the company

AltiSales is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, technology, and operations of Sales and Sales Development. AltiSales lives in the intersection of 3 industries: Software (www.gtmcaddy.io), Consulting & Outsourcing, and Venture Capital. We work with clients to create a sustainable and scalable revenue engine that can later be brought in-house as the teams grow from a few BDEs to dozens of them.




AltiSales was founded in 2012 by Tito Bohrt, who is a well recognized LinkedIn influencer in Business Development and who advocates for strategic & thoughtful outbound, rather than spray & pray. Tito has hired and trained over 200 SDRs including some of the best performers at public companies like Citrix. Today Tito leads AltiSales and writes articles for Sales Hacker, Forbes, and his personal blog on LinkedIn.




Our Core Values are:

Excellence and Thoughtfulness: We understand that excellence is contagious and inspire others with our thirst for it. Excellence is about thoughtfulness, quality of our work outputs, and the outcomes we deliver, not about the volume of work we produce or the hours we work. The speed and volume of work must be combined with extreme attention to detail and thoughtfulness to be valuable. Sloppy AI-generated work is frowned upon. We hate mediocrity and excuses.

Additional Exciting Perks: We offer a range of cool benefits including health reimbursement, fitness stipend, and more.







The role

As a Founding GTM Engineering Leader, you'll own the targeting and data engine behind many of our client programs. We call it "Founding" because for each new client, you'll start from little more than a website and build the go-to-market motion: who to sell to, which accounts matter most, who to talk to inside them and what to say. You'll work across many clients and industries at once, all B2B and mostly enterprise. 

Your counterparts will be our SDR Leaders. They are in charge of messaging across channels (phone, email, linkedin, etc), email copy, responses, pipeline management and even SDR & AE training. This role solely covers the "Data Universe" to "Enriched MQL" part of the funnel.

Reports to: Tito Bohrt, Founder and CEO

Step 1: Loom project




First, watch the Loom I made for the role! https://www.loom.com/share/5657cc4a0bd74b1cbb98654967156be9




Then, record a 5 to 10 minute Loom walking us through a real project you built.




Pick a project you did with a relatively small TAM (ideally B2B Enterprise, but anything with under 50,000 Accounts in TAM is valid), where finding and ranking the right accounts took real work. Show us:

NOTE: Do not talk about your deliverability / positive reply at all. Do not show custom tools / scrapers. That's not what we care about. I want to hear your STRATEGY and the 'why behind the what'




Show the actual work on screen, not slides about it. Send the link to tito@altisales.com.

description:
About Ingredion

Join Ingredion, where innovation impacts lives worldwide! Without even realizing it, you’ve experienced our work in your favorite chocolate, your pet’s food, the paper you write on, and your everyday snacks. As a global powerhouse across more than 60 industries, we harness the potential of natural ingredients to transform lives. Whether you’re just starting your career or bringing years of experience, there's a place for you here to make a real difference. Be part of our team that values a wide range of perspectives and is committed to shaping a better world with every product we create.

Position Title: Director, Global Sales Operations

Location: Bridgewater NJ / Westchester Ill. / or Mexico City / Guadalajara

Workplace type: Hybrid/ On Site

As Director, Global Sales Operations, you will be accountable for developing and implementing strategies that optimize Ingredion’s global sales processes, tools, and ultimately performance, ensuring measurable business results. You will be responsible for establishing standard governance frameworks for forecasting, pipeline management, and operational standards in consideration of regional requirements. Partnering closely with regional Sales Excellence Leaders, you will drive efficiency and growth through consistent processes and capability development. Key responsibilities include assessing sales teams and managers, identifying gaps, and implementing targeted development programs. You will also oversee process design, technology solutions, and training initiatives, while leveraging CRM analytics to deliver actionable insights on opportunities, pipeline health, and performance trends.

This role report to the Senior Director, Commercial Capabilities Development, Customer Experience and Solution Selling, and is directly supported by a Senior Manager, Sales Excellence Program Development .

Ensuring systems and processes run smoothly within our sales organization to deliver the best customer experience measured through our customer surveys.

Head of Customer and Solutions Marketing at BairesDev




Head of Customer and Solutions Marketing at BairesDev




In this role, you'll build and lead a new Customer Marketing area from the ground up, reporting directly to the CMO. This is a hands-on leadership position where you'll turn our existing client base and our sales collateral into a genuine growth lever for the company. - 8+ years of overall B2B marketing experience, including 4+ years in a leadership role.

- 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Product Marketing Manager or Director, owning positioning, messaging, and launches at a B2B company.

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Economics, or Engineering.

- Experience in customer marketing, including upsell/cross-sell campaigns, client case studies and references, client events and webinars, and ABM to existing accounts.

- Proficiency in copy management, including briefing, editing, and quality control of B2B copy, and managing writers.




Nice to have:




- Background in IT services, nearshore software outsourcing, or IT staffing (e.g., Globant, EPAM, Endava, Toptal, Thoughtworks, Accenture).

- Experience building a marketing function or team from zero inside a company of 1,000+ employees.

- Prior experience reporting directly to a CMO or sitting on an executive leadership team.




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. description:
Join a team that puts people at the center of everything.




At TLNT, we believe that recruitment is more than just filling roles — it's about connecting humans with humans. We're a people-first organization partnering with top U.S. companies to help them grow by attracting exceptional talent, and we know that the right content can open the right doors.




This is an excellent opportunity to grow your career with a leading US-based company — fully remote.




You'll join a fast-growing, woman-owned clean skincare brand, handmade in small batches in Florida with simple, fragrance-free ingredients. It started in a kitchen, outgrew a barn and then a warehouse, and today speaks to a community of more than half a million followers on social media — an audience that shows up for real people, real products, and honest ingredient education, not filters.




As Video Editor (Paid Social), you'll turn the in-house team's raw footage and product and lifestyle photography into polished, high-performing content for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. The marketing team owns strategy, concepts, and briefs; you own the edit — video first, supported by static design and graphics.




This is not an entry-level role. You've spent years editing short-form for established e-commerce or DTC brands, and you know how to package a physical product so it sells. Most content is organic, and the best performers become paid ads. Expected output is around 10–15 videos and 10–15 graphics a week. The focus is editing and creative development — not filming, photography, or account management.




What You'll Do

Short-form video. Edit Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts from raw footage, following creative briefs and brand guidelines.

What You Bring

description:
About Homera Health

Homera Health has built some of today’s largest and fastest-growing direct-to-consumer (D2C) telemedicine brands. As we expand existing and new market operations, we’re hiring world-class talent across product design, front-end and back-end engineering, digital marketing, and operations to join us in building the next generation of virtual healthcare experiences.

About The Role

Homera Health is hiring a Performance Ad Designer to create high-converting paid social ad creative, conversion-focused landing pages, and web experiences for one of our newest brands.

We are looking for someone with direct-to-consumer (DTC) experience who understands how to create compelling designs that drive consumer interest and sales. You have experience designing for both digital marketing campaigns and physical consumer products, with a portfolio that demonstrates your ability to translate a brand's value into effective visual communication.

This is a growth-focused, direct-response design role, not a traditional product UI/UX position.

You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy iteration, data-informed design decisions, and creating visuals that contribute to measurable business results.

Responsibilities


Design high-velocity paid social creative (primarily Meta), including static ads, carousels, and lightweight motion/video variations. 
Create conversion-focused landing pages and funnel sections in Figma, optimizing for message match, trust, offer clarity, and form flow. 
Develop creative assets for DTC campaigns, ensuring visual consistency across paid ads, websites, and other consumer touchpoints. 
Design visual concepts and marketing materials for physical consumer products, including product packaging, labels, inserts, or other product-related assets. 
Collaborate with Marketing to define creative testing priorities and rapidly iterate based on performance insights. 
Work closely with developers to ensure designs are modular, buildable, and fast to ship. 
Maintain and evolve a lightweight performance creative system, including templates, components, naming conventions, and asset libraries. 
Support website refreshes or redesigns as needed to improve conversion and brand consistency. 
Use data, feedback, and test results to refine both ad creative and web experiences. 


Qualifications


4+ years of experience in performance creative design, DTC brand design, or direct-response marketing design. 
Direct, hands-on experience designing for US-based DTC brands that sell online, in-house or through an agency, including paid social and display ads and conversion-focused landing pages, with an understanding of how design supports customer acquisition, engagement, and sales.

As a Senior Account Executive at Amazon Ads Mexico, you will own the strategy and growth of a portfolio of the largest and most complex advertisers in Mexico. With a consultative approach and deep expertise in advertising technology and measurement, you will be a trusted advisor to senior marketing and media leaders. You will design integrated solutions across streaming TV, Prime Video, live sports, Twitch, display, audio and Sponsored Ads that help them reach their business goals. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, tackle ambiguous problems, and influence the direction of the broader sales organization.

Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers, agencies, authors and entrepreneurs. Our ad solutions, including sponsored ads, display, streaming TV/video, audio and custom ads, use Amazon's innovations and insights to find, attract and engage audiences throughout their daily journeys. With flexible pricing and buying models, including self-service, managed service and programmatic buying, these solutions help businesses build brand awareness, grow sales and more.

This is an opportunity to lead relationships with some of the largest brands and agency holding companies in the market, and to shape how they invest in video and advanced advertising. If you have a consultative selling style, experience selling advertising at a leading technology or digital platform company, and a passion for developing others while delivering strategic, data-driven solutions, apply today!

Own the account strategy for a portfolio of top advertisers, including multi-year growth plans and annual commitment negotiations.

Lead executive engagement by building relationships with C-level and senior media and marketing leaders at advertisers and agencies.

Build and run full-funnel strategies, from big ideas to analytical recommendations, with video as a key driver of growth.

Serve as an ad tech and measurement subject matter expert for the team. Coach peers on DSP activation, programmatic deals, clean rooms and advanced measurement.

Design measurement plans, such as brand lift, reach and frequency analysis, and attribution, that show the business impact of your clients' investments.

Mentor and coach other sellers, give feedback on client pitches, and help onboard new team members.

Build best practices that scale across the team, such as playbooks, account planning frameworks and AI-driven automations.

Influence product and leadership by bringing customer and market insights into product roadmaps and business planning.

Use Salesforce, data and generative AI tools to manage pipeline, track account health and forecast against quarterly goals.

Keep up with trends in the advertising industry, ad tech and the competitive landscape in Mexico.

This role requires five days a week in the office, with travel as needed.

description:
For the curious writers and search obsessed.

You know that feeling when you search for something and find an article that actually answers your question, no robotic filler, no keyword stuffing, just great taste and genuine utility? That’s the exact energy we care about.

We’re looking for an Editorial Content Specialist who loves the sweet spot where storytelling meets search intelligence. Someone who crafts pieces creative pros actually want to read, while understanding how modern search and answer engines discover and surface that work.

A Little About Us

Envato is an all-in-one creative toolkit, bringing together world-class creative assets and purpose-built AI tools to help people make their ideas real.

Our community is made up of designers, filmmakers, editors and creators who care about craft, love experimenting and are always looking for the next tool, technique or spark of inspiration to make better work.

What’s the gig?

You’ll be creating and editing tutorials, guides, and articles that solve real problems for creative pros. You’ll be digging into search trends and AI search behaviours to find untapped content gaps, producing fresh pieces that rank in traditional search and get cited in AI answer overviews.

You’ll be using generative AI daily to speed up your ideation and drafting, always backing it up with your sharp editorial eye so everything sounds human, clear, and on-brand.

You’ll also be publishing directly in WordPress, curating visuals from Envato, optimising internal links, and checking performance data to iterate on what works best alongside our Search Visibility team and external contributors.

Sound like you?

You have 5+ years of experience in writing, content marketing, or editorial roles, ideally within creative tools or tech. You know organic search inside out and already understand how answer engine optimization (AEO) and AI summaries work.

Generative AI is a natural part of your daily creative workflow, you’re confident managing content in WordPress, and you communicate fluently in both English and Spanish. Most of all, you bring strong editorial judgement and take pride in work that real humans enjoy reading.

Show Us What You’ve Got

Send us 2–3 writing samples or live links you’re proud of that showcase your editorial tone, storytelling skills, and how you explain creative concepts clearly.

Life at Envato

We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values  : Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow.

Our benefits in Mexico include 30 days of Christmas bonus pay, 12 days of vacation in your first year, a 100% vacation bonus, monthly grocery vouchers, a 5% savings fund, private health insurance, home office, team connection & learning budgets, wellbeing and study support, volunteer leave, generous paid parental leave, access to all our products, the option to apply to work from another remote location for up to 3 months per year, plus our Conoce México benefit to help you explore more of Mexico.

A few things before you apply

We embrace diversity at Envato and want to ensure that everyone who applies for a role with us has an inclusive experience. Hiring for us isn't a tick box exercise, we want to know what you're passionate about, what our lived experiences are and what you think you can add to the team. We're also big believers in using AI, and that includes how we hire. We may use AI tools to help support our recruitment process, but they don't replace human judgement. Our people always make the final hiring decisions.

By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy . We encourage you to read it before applying to understand how we collect, use and handle your personal information. We appreciate the time you’ve taken to apply to Envato and we're committed to responding to every applicant.

You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024.

title: Emerging Channels Sr. Manager
skills: Channel Strategy and Prioritization: Define and execute the Emerging Channels strategy across Latin America (LATAM), setting priorities by channel, market, and customer. Assess consumer consumption occasions, potential outlet coverage, current brand performance, projected sales volume, brand visibility, execution feasibility, and profitability to identify growth opportunities and guide resource allocation.

Channel Expansion and Strategic Partnerships: Identify and pursue regional and local business opportunities in collaboration with bottlers, global and regional key accounts, quick-service restaurant chains, catering operators, vending partners, and digital platforms. Manage commercial initiatives from opportunity identification and proposal preparation through negotiations, implementation, and post-launch performance evaluation.

Customer Value Propositions and Joint Business Planning: Design of customer specific value propositions and joint business plans aimed at increasing category value, attracting new consumers, and expanding consumption occasions.

Define initiatives covering product portfolio listings, meal combinations, snacking occasions, specialty beverages and nonalcoholic cocktails, accessible pricing, promotional calendars, branded coolers, customer incentives, and experiential activations.

Channel Execution and Commercial Standards: Establish channel-specific execution standards for product availability, portfolio assortment, pricing, competitive positioning against carbonated soft drinks, chilled-product placement, brand visibility, physical and digital menu presence, and promotional activities. Work with country teams and bottlers to monitor outlet performance, address execution gaps, and ensure consistent application of agreed standards.

Cross-Functional Alignment and Bottler Collaboration: Coordinate global, regional, and local stakeholders to align commercial priorities and support effective execution across markets. Partner with bottlers and customers, engage Marketing and Trade Marketing teams in initiative planning, facilitate required brand approvals, and ensure projected incremental demand is reflected in Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP).

Pilot Programs and Market Expansion: Lead pilot initiatives by defining objectives, financial assumptions, operational requirements, and performance indicators. Assess outcomes, capture lessons learned, establish implementation guidelines, and replicate successful approaches across customers and markets. Support capability building through guidance and training for country teams and bottler partners.

Business Analytics and Performance Management: Maintain performance scorecards and analytical tools to inform commercial decisions across channels, customers, countries, and bottlers. Leverage internal and external data to assess growth drivers, untapped opportunities, and barriers to expansion. Track sales volume, distribution, rate of sale, product availability, commercial investments, and initiative performance against established objectives.

Financial Assessment and Investment Prioritization: Evaluate business cases and financial viability across the value chain, considering consumer pricing, profit margins, customer and bottler economics, commercial and marketing investments, and projected incremental sales volume. Recommend investment priorities, resource allocation, and corrective actions based on financial and operational results.

People leadership and operating discipline: Set priorities and performance expectations for the team, establish a consistent operating cadence, remove barriers and foster collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement and disciplined follow-through.
Prefer a Bachelor's Degree in the field of Business Administration, Management, Finance, Marketing, Economics or a related field
Additional Experience Desired: More than 5 years of experience in business development, key account management
Additional Experience Desired: Between 3-5 years of experience in channel ownership and commercial strategy leadership
Computer Skills Desired: Advanced Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; strong proficiency in Power BI or comparable Business Intelligence (BI) tools.

Additional Knowledge or Skills to be Successful in this role: Master’s degree preferred. Fluency in English and Spanish required; Portuguese strongly preferred. Experience managing direct reports and regional initiatives required. Background in beverages, Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), foodservice, or bottler operations strongly preferred. Demonstrated expertise in customer negotiations, Joint Business Plans (JBPs), channel profitability, pricing, business cases, field execution, and product launches.

description:
Role Title: Product Marketing Reviewer (Remote)
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote




What We're Researching

We're running a paid study on go-to-market strategies tailored to independent retail operations. Specifically, we are evaluating a new appointment management tool designed for independent bicycle repair shops. This research helps us refine our initial product positioning and identify hidden risks before launch.




How It Works

You will complete an asynchronous, remote review of a short go-to-market brief. During this task, you will read through our target audience assumptions, proposed messaging, and launch plan. Next, you will write a short report that clearly separates unsubstantiated assumptions from hard evidence. Finally, you will recommend one low-cost validation step to test our riskiest assumption without conducting new market outreach.




Who This Is For

We welcome Product Marketing Managers, GTM Strategists, and early-stage Product Managers with experience in retail software or small business tools. Candidates should have a strong grasp of market validation techniques and startup strategy. Familiarity with independent bike shops or local service businesses is a strong plus, though not strictly required.




What You’ll Do

1. You will complete an asynchronous, remote review of a short go-to-market brief.

2. During this task, you will read through our target audience assumptions, proposed messaging, and launch plan.

3. Next, you will write a short report that clearly separates unsubstantiated assumptions from hard evidence.

4. Finally, you will recommend one low-cost validation step to test our riskiest assumption without conducting new market outreach.

The Hershey Company (NYSE: HSY) es una empresa líder en la industria de snacks, reconocida por crear más momentos de felicidad a través de sus marcas icónicas. Con un sólido portafolio en chocolate, confitería y snacks salados, Hershey deleita a los consumidores todos los días. Nuestras marcas más reconocidas incluyen Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers y muchas más. En Hershey estamos comprometidos a generar un impacto positivo en las comunidades donde vivimos, trabajamos y hacemos negocios. Este compromiso nació con nuestro fundador, Milton Hershey, y continúa definiendo quiénes somos hoy. Guiados por nuestra propuesta de valor para los colaboradores, Lead Today. Create Tomorrow, empoderamos a nuestra gente para generar impacto hoy mientras construyen el mañana. Nuestra mentalidad One Hershey une equipos a través de funciones, geografías y negocios, permitiéndonos operar con rapidez, colaboración y un propósito compartido. The Hershey Company se enorgullece de ser reconocida como uno de los mejores empleadores, reflejando nuestro compromiso con nuestra gente, nuestra cultura y nuestro propósito.

¿Cómo encajarás en el panorama general?

Buscamos un Revenue Growth Management Specialist (RGM) para apoyar la planeación, análisis y optimización de las inversiones promocionales de Hershey México.

Esta posición tiene un fuerte enfoque estratégico, siendo responsable de evaluar el desempeño de promociones, administrar inversiones comerciales y generar recomendaciones basadas en datos que permitan maximizar el retorno de inversión de las actividades promocionales.

Trabajarás de manera cercana con los equipos de Ventas, Finanzas Comerciales, Marketing y Planeación de Demanda para apoyar la toma de decisiones comerciales y asegurar una gestión eficiente de los recursos promocionales.

Importante: Esta no es una posición de Trade Marketing enfocada en activaciones, ejecución en punto de venta o materiales promocionales. El rol está orientado al análisis financiero, planeación promocional y optimización de inversiones comerciales.

¿Qué harás?

Analizar el desempeño de promociones comerciales a nivel cliente, canal y categoría para identificar oportunidades de mejora en ventas, rentabilidad y retorno de inversión.

Desarrollar análisis y recomendaciones que apoyen la construcción de estrategias promocionales alineadas a los objetivos comerciales del negocio.

Colaborar con los equipos de Ventas y Finanzas Comerciales en la elaboración y seguimiento de planes promocionales anuales y trimestrales.

Evaluar la efectividad de eventos promocionales y generar insights accionables para optimizar futuras inversiones comerciales.

Administrar y monitorear presupuestos promocionales mediante herramientas de gestión comercial, asegurando precisión, cumplimiento de procesos internos y correcto registro financiero.

Dar seguimiento a aprobaciones, controles y provisiones relacionadas con inversiones promocionales.

Elaborar reportes, análisis y presentaciones ejecutivas para distintos grupos de interés dentro de la organización.

Brindar soporte a usuarios de herramientas de gestión promocional y coordinar mejoras o resolución de incidencias con equipos de Sistemas y Servicios Compartidos.

description:
Responsibilities
Team Intro
The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.

With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build an commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

We are looking for a passionate and strategic Creator Incubation Manager (Electronics Category) to join our team. You will be responsible for nurturing and elevating high-potential e-commerce creators, helping them master content creation techniques to drive their GMV growth. Rather than general creator recruitment, your core focus will be matching the right creators with curated category product assortments, co-creating high-impact content to achieve explosive sales growth. Additionally, you will provide hands-on training for agency and individual livestream hosts, guiding them on livestream tools, scripts, and post-session data reviews. A key part of your role will be translating data into actionable strategies and successfully persuading creators to adopt them for continuous performance improvement.

Responsibilities:
- Empower and incubate high-potential e-commerce creators by guiding them on e-commerce content production techniques, increasing their posting frequency and content quality, and ultimately driving their GMV growth.
- Deeply understand curated product assortments within focus categories and identify the most suitable creators for them. Co-create compelling content with these creators to achieve massive sales breakthroughs that outpace the broader market.
- Provide comprehensive training and guidance for agency hosts and individual livestreamers. Help them master livestreaming tools, refine and optimize their on-camera scripts (talk tracks), and encourage higher streaming frequency to maximize the ROI of each session.
- Conduct in-depth post-livestream data reviews with creators. Leverage data analysis to formulate highly actionable strategies, successfully persuade hosts/creators to adopt these recommendations, and track execution to ensure improved results.
- Ensure creators maintain high-quality content standards and adhere to platform guidelines to build a healthy and sustainable e-commerce ecosystem.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the distinct ability to translate data into actionable plans and successfully persuade creators/hosts to execute them.
- Deep understanding of e-commerce content (short video & livestreaming) and the ability to co-create content strategies that perfectly match specific product assortments.
- Service-oriented mindset, patience, and excellent communication skills to deeply coach, train, and build trust with creators and agency hosts.

Preferred Qualifications:
- 3+ years of experience in e-commerce operations, creator incubation, or livestreaming management.
- Proven track record of delivering comprehensive livestream training, optimizing livestream scripts, and driving measurable GMV growth for creators or brands.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request​

title: TikTok Commerce - Consumables Category Account Manager
description:
Responsibilities
The LATAM Operations team drives TikTok Shop's business in Latin America, operating across markets including Mexico and Brazil. We handle full-cycle seller onboarding, brand incubation and acceleration, creator ecosystem development, campaign execution, cross-border operational capability building, and end-to-end buyer experience.

We are organized into vertical Category Management teams covering brand expansion, localized category operations, and merchant lifecycle growth, alongside centralized functions for creator operations, campaign operations, project management, and agency partnerships. Working closely with product, commercial, logistics, and governance teams, we tailor local strategies for merchants ranging from emerging local sellers to international brands.

You will help build content commerce models designed for Latin American consumption patterns, shaping the experience for sellers, creators, and buyers across the region.

The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.

With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build an commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

Responsibilities
- Recruit top health, food and beverage business partners in Mexico to TikTok;
- Recruit business partners and guide them to join the platform, upload products, connect them with necessary technical support, and assist in product selection;
- Develop TikTok content strategies for partners, leveraging partners' in-house teams, agencies, and influencers to grow their TikTok business;
- Collaborate with partners to develop medium and long-term commerce strategies, including product selection, content, campaign, and new product introductions, to ensure long-term success;
- Encourage partners to improve product and service quality, enhancing the platform’s ecosystem.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree or higher, with over 2 years of experience in the health, food and beverage industry and at least 1 years in commerce.
- Knowledge of the Mexican market ecosystem, regulatory policies, leading brands, and the latest trends;
- Results-oriented, with strong self-motivation and responsibility;
- Data-sensitive, able to set clear goals and monitor progress; 
- Fluency in both English and Spanish.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Capable of analyzing complex business issues, identifying opportunities, and continuously optimizing strategies;

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​
